chapter: Handy, Bix and disputes over credit
title: Raymond Burke's tapes
summary: The interviewer says Raymond Burke praised La Rocca; he says Burke played with him only once or twice.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Now, Mr. LaRocco, I want to tell you that we made some tapes Saturday night of Raymond Burke, who used to work with you. You remember?
He didn't work with me. Didn't work with you? No. He played with me once or twice. Yes. I know Larry Burke. You know who Larry Burke is? He's Jules Kazard's nephew. Yes.

And he had some very nice things to say about you and talked about your playing. So you'll be happy to know that other people are backing your story up. If you go to the musicians, some of them will. And Raymond is one of them who will back you up.
